// diagnostic

E2930

This {role} has no accessible label

What

This {role} has no accessible label

Why

Screen readers announce a control by its accessible label; an empty label is invisible to assistive tech.

Fix

Pass a real label, e.g. `ui.node_role("Submit", w, h, ui.aria_role_button())`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2930: tests/ui_lint/a11y_unlabeled_control.warn.
